title: Non-anchor position period prediction
rationale: Test whether predeclared position-period rules predict held-out K4 position classes before any key-material expansion or fragment-score tuning.
prediction_target: Before scoring any candidate words, emit non-anchor residue-class targets for each registered period in {2,3,4,5,7,8,13,14}; future independent evidence must use a best-of-period control unless a single period is independently justified first.
discovery_inputs: Residue classes emitted before observing new score output
evaluation_inputs: Withheld non-anchor K4 position residue classes
Future source-documented fragment rows, if independently obtained
